scenes.say: Can you guess? Six easy questions about motorsport beyond Formula One. Three seconds each!
Question one. How long is the big race at Le Mans? Six hours, twelve, or a full day?
A full day, twenty-four hours! Drivers take turns behind the wheel.
Question two. What number did Valentino Rossi race with? Ninety-three, forty-six, or ninety-nine?
Forty-six! In twenty twenty-two MotoGP retired it for good in his honour.
Question three. What powers a Formula E car? Petrol, electricity, or hydrogen?
Electricity only! That's how it's been since the very first race in Beijing in twenty fourteen.
Question four. Which way do NASCAR cars turn on ovals? Left only, right only, or both ways?
Left only: ovals run counterclockwise. They turn right only on road courses.
Question five. Where is the famous Indy five hundred held? Monaco, Indianapolis, or Daytona?
Indianapolis! Two hundred laps of the oval, five hundred miles exactly.
Last one. Who holds the rally record of nine world titles? Loeb, Ogier, or both?
Both! Ogier matched Loeb in twenty twenty-five, nine titles each.
Six out of six: you're a motorsport expert! Four or five: a solid fan. Fewer: time to look beyond Formula One.
